status: Amended 2026-10-13 per user: match existing Pd filtering/baseline; no detrending or ocular-proxy rejection. Exploratory, not preregistered.
units_basis: User endorses prior plot convention on 2026-10-13; GDF header does not independently establish physical units
reference: Acquired at FCz per user; primary preserves recording reference; mean-scalp reference sensitivity excludes FCZ
spectral_method: Single-trial Hann periodogram on continuously 0.1–20 Hz filtered and −0.2–0 s baseline-corrected EEG; detrend=False; density scaling, native 384-point FFT (1.333 Hz spacing); sum PSD bins whose centers fall in band times bin spacing
theta_interpretation: Broad event-related 0.10-0.85 s total power; response and immediate feedback overlap possible; not pure anticipatory control
erp_filter_method: MNE FIR zero-phase firwin on continuous recording; matches existing ERP pipeline
artifact_policy: User correction 2026-10-13: filter continuous EEG and baseline correct before general amplitude QC; no linear detrending, FP1/FP2/FPZ rejection, horizontal-eye proxy, or EOG correction. Flag peak-to-peak >150 µV only on each measure's electrodes: PO7/PO8 across the existing Pd epoch [-.5,1), posterior alpha ROI in [-.85,-.1), theta frontal ROI in both [-.85,-.1) and [.1,.85). Retain 100/200 µV sensitivity flags and every trial; no automatic deletion. These are amplitude flags, not confirmed ocular artifacts. EOG calibration is a last-resort follow-up only. Require >=20 distractor and >=20 no-distractor trials per subject/session for spectral summaries; >=10 per distractor side for lateral ERP.
window_rationale: Pd matches the existing −0.5–1 s stimulus epoch and −0.2–0 baseline; late mean remains 0.5–0.9 s. The separate 750 ms alpha/theta windows are exploratory spectral choices, not the Pd epoch. The prestimulus window starts 850 ms BEFORE stimulus and must be within verified fixation. No blanket −0.85–0.9 s rejection rule remains.
run_weighting: Pool retained trials within session for spectral means; ERP side means averaged equally after pooling retained trials; separate unclean equal-run sensitivity against saved ERP source
multiple_testing: Holm across three candidate primary group-change tests; sensitivity and association families labeled separately
behavioral_clock: Per user, GDF Status RT at 512 Hz is preferred; verified text milliseconds are a labeled fallback only when Status response is absent. GDF-only sensitivity required. Missing Status samples are never synthesized.
